scenario: RC1 controlled library and first-scan profiles

questions.1_written_scenario: pass: README and archived harness specify inputs, scope and metrics
questions.2_same_build_profile: pass: optimized unstripped profiling builds, separate from timing binaries; receipts archived
questions.3_api_matched: pass: library identical GetLanguage entrypoints; scanner profiles describe one implementation, not a cross-API comparison
questions.4_pragmas_identical: pass: recorded fixed Go runtime controls and identical scanner configuration between baseline and profiles
questions.5_realistic_workload: pass: complete upstream sample microbenchmark plus pinned ripgrep, jq and Roslyn scenarios
questions.6_same_fixture: pass: immutable read-only pinned Git and verified raw-blob directory views; hashes recorded
questions.7_warmup_symmetric: pass: three excluded fresh-process warmups before each unprofiled scenario
questions.8_N_sufficient: pass: 20 or 100 fresh process samples and more than ten measured seconds per baseline cell; profiles separate
questions.9_host_quiet: waive: builds and benchmarks serialized by orchestration, but Docker host applications, governor, SMT and frequency were not isolated or independently monitored
questions.10_variance_envelope: waive: only one window; small scanner CV about27% with unresolved p95 drift, retained as qualitative diagnostic only; library and Roslyn CV about1%
questions.11_three_tier_reporting: pass: library losses labeled BelowParity in linked baseline; scanner profiles make no cross-implementation speed verdict
questions.12_losses_published: pass: library losses and all small-scanner noise retained; no discarded samples
questions.13_apples_flagged: pass: Scan/process/warm API and cumulative allocation/RSS scopes explicitly separated
questions.14_reproducible: waive: complete local input/build/harness/raw evidence retained; independent same-host repeatability within an envelope has not been demonstrated

claim_scope: Measured attribution and optimization hypotheses; not universal performance or resolved small-case latency distributions.
